ayanna-davis.text: To address the housing crisis, I will work to cut red tape and streamline permitting so we can rapidly build more affordable housing for working families, and advocate for pathways to homeownership.

ayanna-davis.text: Will push for investments in supportive and mental health programs aimed at addressing the root causes of homelessness.

ayanna-davis.text: Will work with local first responders to improve emergency response times and create safer schools, parks and neighborhoods; advocates more funding for after-school and job-training programs; will push for stronger gun safety laws, especially targeting ghost guns.

source.title: Ayanna Davis for Assembly - Priorities: Public Safety

ayanna-davis.text: In the Assembly, I'll fight to raise wages, improve workplace protections, and expand healthcare and retirement benefits for workers in our state.

ayanna-davis.text: I believe healthcare is a fundamental right, not a privilege. I will fight to ensure every Californian can access the care they need without going into debt.

ayanna-davis.text: Will support investments in green technology for clean air and water, and work with labor unions on a just transition to a greener economy that protects working families' livelihoods.

ayanna-davis.text: Pledges to expand access to quality legal services for immigrant families, safeguard access to safe and legal abortion and expand reproductive health services, and advocate for LGBTQ+ civil rights.

ayanna-davis.text: Will fully fund public education, increase classroom teacher pay, expand STEM, arts and after-school programs, and make higher education more accessible. Cites 30+ years in public education as teacher, principal and Compton school board member.

ayanna-davis.text: Said her top priorities include keeping ICE off school campuses and strengthening protections for immigrant students and families; vowed to fight to protect and expand Medi-Cal and affordable care access.
